paragraphs: Qoria, formerly Family Zone, describes itself as a global technology company working to keep children safe in their digital lives. The homepage groups several brands under Qoria, including Linewize, Smoothwall, Qustodio, and ySafe. Smoothwall is described as a pioneer in digital safeguarding solutions for schools in the UK, while Qustodio sells parental control tools.

The solutions page sets out classroom internet management, content filtering, and a firewall as products that reduce exposure to risk. Monitor alerts pastoral teams to students at risk based on digital behaviours, and Pulse is a 60-second weekly check-in that asks students to speak up. Training and consultancy teams, the Online Safety Hub, and the Digital Experts Academy support school staff and students.

Granular reporting covers trends over time, and school district and MAT leaders can report organisation-wide or per school. The story page counts 650 people across 10 countries, 32,000 schools, 9 million parents and 30 million children. Aura has announced a binding agreement under which it proposes to acquire Qoria.

quote.text: Closing the gaps that children fall through
